teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

facts.label: Noite de perguntas
facts.sub: Muitos bares americanos fazem uma noite semanal de perguntas e respostas. Os times escrevem as respostas em papel, e o time com mais pontos ganha um prêmio ou um vale-bebida.

facts.label: Prazo
facts.sub: No trabalho, o prazo para entregar um relatório costuma ser rígido. Chegar a tempo mostra respeito. Se for atrasar, avise a equipe cedo e combine uma nova data com educação.

pages.title: The end of the week · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in Denver. Jake sits at his desk in a quiet office. He has a big spreadsheet and an invoice to send. The deadline is five o’clock, and the clock is slow. He yawns and drinks his third coffee. His coworker Nora walks over with a happy face.
“Finally, it’s Friday! You look exhausted.” says Nora. “Yes, my week is long, but good.” says Jake. “Do you finish the spreadsheet before the deadline?” says Nora.

paragraphs: “Can I invite my brother too? He loves trivia.” says Jake. “Sure, the more the better. See you at the door!” says Nora. Jake smiles for the first time today.
